text: The social and mental properties of decision makers in financial institutions, combined with the incentive structure of the respective institutional setup, determine a financial institution's adaptive capability.
citation: Wulf A. Kaal, Dynamic Regulation of the Financial Services Industry (2013). SSRN: https://ssrn.com/abstract=2273857

isBasedOn.name: Dynamic Regulation of the Financial Services Industry

abstract: Social and mental properties of decision makers in financial institutions together with the incentive structure in the respective institutional setups can help determine a financial institution's adaptive capability.
